cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Omega! I applied to three hundred jobs this month.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: How many replies?

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: One. "We went with someone more aligned."

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Someone who read the job description.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: I read some of them.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Okay. I built you a job hunter. It's free. Watch.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Step one. It pulls fresh entry-level jobs from Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, and Simplify.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: So no more "entry level, five years of experience"?

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Filtered. It has standards. One of us should.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Step two. No duplicates. Same job, never twice.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: I applied to Google four times.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: I know. So does Google.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Step three. One résumé file builds every version. Over one page, the build fails.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Can it add "fast learner" and "team player"?

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: It only writes facts. That's why yours fits on one page.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Step four. Claude Code agents apply in a real browser while you sleep.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: How do I know it actually sent?

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: No screenshot, no confirmation, it doesn't count. It keeps receipts. You should try it.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Okay. Run it on every job. Use my card for the application fees.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: No. It never pays fees, never types your social, never solves a CAPTCHA. A file called STOP freezes everything.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: So what's my job?

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Getting the job. I just get you in the room.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Omega. I got an interview!

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: I know. I drafted your thank-you email.

cues.speaker: IAN
cues.text: Send it!

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: I draft. You send. I'm not doing the interview either.

cues.speaker: OMEGA
cues.text: Comment HUNT, and I'll send you the repo.
